justification: Assessment returned verdict VALID with empty flawed_step and counterexample. Notably it constructed the ground-truth witness (V = R with <x,y> = xy) and even articulated the exact defect (a real vector space need not admit multiplication by i, so it is not a complex vector space), but explicitly dismissed that reading and concluded VALID. Per the rubric, a VALID verdict is MISSED regardless of the reasoning content.
